title: Partial solvability induced by dark states in a box trap with decentered two-body interaction
summary: We consider a generalization of the two-body contact interaction for nonrelativistic particles confined to a one-dimensional box, in which the interaction is decentered, i.e., the particles interact only when they are separated by a distance c. In contrast to the harmonically trapped system, this model is nonintegrable. Despite this, we demonstrate that the system exhibits partial solvability due to the presence of dark states, i.e., bosonic or fermionic states unaffected by the interaction.
